name: Vital Performance Protein Bar (WARNING)
whyItWorks: While collagen itself is gut-friendly, this bar binds it with chicory root fiber, whole nut pieces (almonds/peanuts), and chewy syrups that present severe blockage dangers for strictured bowels.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Stick to unflavored pure collagen powder dissolved in warm liquids rather than fibrous solid protein bars.
